You just named today's job. Now the idea: Upload a file. Then you will do the lab.

blocks.heading: Upload a file
blocks.body:
Last week **Assets** was ‘the library the Image block points at’. Today you put a file in that library.

Upload. Give it a **title** (a name in the library) and a **description**. Move it into a folder you are allowed to use. Write the path.

A typical path looks like `/content/dam/kitepump/beach-card.jpg`. That is not a DITA `href`. Do not mix the two pointers.

Do not dump the photo into this git repo. The library is AEM, not the course folder.

If you have no AEM, write the path you would use and label the mock.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: One file, title, description, path.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You commit a huge photo to git, or you paste a copyrighted Adobe screenshot, or the path is missing.

Expected: Path plus title plus description. Git stays small. Mock labeled if no instance.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to One file, title, description, path.
blocks.intro: How to One file, title, description, path. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: One file, title, description, path
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: If you have AEM: Assets, upload a small photo you own or a public-domain picture. Title. Description. Do not steal a vendor screenshot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Move it to a folder you are allowed to use. Write the path in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week11/field-log-73.txt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: If you do not have AEM: write the path you would use, for example /content/dam/kitepump/beach-card.jpg, and label it mock.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Write: this path is not a DITA image href. Guides may store DITA pictures in this library later. Still a different pointer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not put a large photo in this git repo. The library lives in AEM.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: Should you put the library file into this course’s git repo?
options: Yes :  so the picture travels with the lesson
No :  the file lives in AEM’s library, not in this git tree
Yes, if it is under 20 MB
blocks.why: Assets live in AEM. This repo stays small.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: You set a title on the file in Assets. Is that the same as the Title block on a page?
options: No :  one is metadata on the file, the other is a heading block on a page
blocks.why: Same English word. File title lives in the library. Page Title is a block.
